identity_anchors: cyan and magenta chromatic aberration (glitch) offset effect
white core fill of the main symbol
must_preserve: The specific geometry of the 'd' note: vertical stem, top-right flag, bottom-left circular loop
The tri-color layering relationship: Cyan offset to the top-left, Magenta/Red offset to the bottom-right, White in the center
The negative space inside the bottom loop of the 'd'
The overall silhouette which must remain recognizable as the Douyin/TikTok logo
can_restyle: Background texture (can add noise, gradient, or pattern as long as it remains dark)
Material finish of the white core (can be glossy, metallic, matte, or neon)
Intensity of the glitch effect (can be softened or sharpened)
Corner radius of the app icon container
Adding subtle ambient glow around the colors
must_not_replace_with: A generic cloud or speech bubble
A cute animal or mascot character
A standard sans-serif letter 'd' without the note flag
color_preservation: The Cyan (#25F4EE approx) and Magenta/Red (#FE2C55 approx) are critical brand identifiers. They must remain distinct hues. The White core can be slightly tinted by the theme but must remain the lightest element. The background must remain dark (black or deep navy) to ensure the neon glitch effect is visible; do not invert to a light background.
structure_summary: A central white glyph resembling a lowercase 'd' or musical note, flanked by a cyan shadow shifted up-left and a red shadow shifted down-right, creating a stereoscopic 3D/glitch effect on a dark square background.
risk_notes: Removing the cyan/red split will destroy brand recognition immediately
Changing the background to white/light gray will ruin the neon aesthetic and make the glitch effect invisible
Altering the curve of the 'd' loop or the angle of the top flag will make it look like a generic music app
